engineDivergence.engineDivergence: Engine siblings exist for classic, modern and rustic. The classic engine emits no data-part and reads no --ds-* channel, so none of the 32 modern parts are addressable under engine=classic. Modern and rustic implement the same semantic contract but rustic writes literal durations inline instead of reading a motion channel.
